    "body": "This PR adds `specs/S-001.md` (status: draft) and `experiments/EXP-001` to `EXP-004`, the spec the Builder works from on the owner's lighter path (`decisions/questions/P-001-build-path.md`).\n\n**The spec:**\n- **Three milestones:**\n  - **M1, AC1 to AC15:** a read-only status page on a preview behind Access.\n  - **M2, AC16 to AC23:** answering cards and questions, plus agent usage and context.\n  - **M3, AC24 to AC28:** planning, then launch on the needs-you address, with no side-by-side period.\n- **Fixes:** it fixes every finding in the Critic's last plan review and carries the owner's five answers.\n- **Deploys:** they run only from `main`. Each one waits for the owner's approval, bound to the commit's SHA. No agent holds a secret, and the deploy step runs nothing from `src/`.\n- **Experiments:** they run on the preview after M1 merges.\n- **Owner time:** estimated at 136 to 161 minutes over two weeks before M1 is accepted.\n\n**Review:** the Reviewer failed rounds 1 to 5 (owner questions, the deploy route, the approval gate, SHA binding, then the launch deploy) and passed round 6 at 2d93c61. Three non-blocking implementation notes go to the Chief of Staff's workflow PR (CS3): `fetch-depth: 0`, a refspec that updates `origin/main`, and AC27's wording to match CS9.\n\n**Open owner questions:** the V5 details, answering in v2.5 projects, the usage fields, the agents' credential and the token's reach, and a custom domain. None of them blocks M1 starting.\n\n`specs/**` and `experiments/**` are R0, so no review records are needed. `check_all.sh . origin/main` passes.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\n\nhttps://claude.ai/code/session_012RJPVKAoLga2RkqLYRDcBY\n\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_012RJPVKAoLga2RkqLYRDcBY)_",
